name: Risk Analysis
tagline: Risks identified, quantified and owned in days, not months.
problem: Risk registers list risks without pricing them, so contingency is a guess.
how: Project documents and comparable risk histories
Identifies, quantifies and assigns every risk
Exposure in dollars and days, carried into contingency
features: Schedule health: DCMA quality checks before any risk is run on the schedule
Three-point risks: Low, likely and high impact in dollars and days for every risk
P50 and P80: Risk-adjusted cost and finish date at P50 and P80
Dual simulation: Schedule-network and risk-register Monte Carlo compared
Design maturity: AACE maturity inputs tied to the estimate class
Live forecasting: Earned value and momentum forecasts in execution
Risk allocation: Contract strategy tested: risk held by the party able to control it
Drafted register: Risks and mitigation options drafted from project documents and comparable histories, for people to approve
notes: No running interface exists for this tool yet, so there are no screens.
